title: Extract duplicated slug logic into one module
prompt: users.py and orders.py contain the same slug-cleaning logic. Move it into a new module textutil.py as normalize_slug(value) and have both modules import and use it, keeping the public functions user_slug and order_slug and all tests passing. Do not modify the test file.

args: python3 -m unittest -q && test -f textutil.py && grep -q textutil users.py && grep -q textutil orders.py
